headlines.text: Back on this day in 2021, Miro vs. Orange Cassidy met in a Tournament Match, headlining the show on Dynamite, rated 6.58.
2023 brought us this moment: Daniel Garcia vs. Trent Beretta closed out Rampage, rated 6.87.
On this day in 2021, Samuray del Sol kicked off their AEW journey, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.25.

secondaries.text: 2021 brought us this moment: it was the first-ever encounter between Andrade El Idolo and Cody Rhodes on Dynamite, rated 6.44.
